messages:
Jared: Who's up for a casual group run + bouldering after work this Wed? 5k jog then ~90min at the new boulder gym near Soma. Meetup 6pm outside the office lobby? :runner::muscle:
Maria: Count me in! Pace check — I run ~8-9 min miles, hope that's okay. :+1:
Connor: I'm in for the bouldering portion but might skip the run — still babysitting a grumpy shin. Can I meet you at the gym around 7pm?
Priya: Love this. Tiny challenge idea: 3 routes each, beat last week's lowest V-grade and you get coffee on me ☕️ :trophy:
Kevin: Quick poll — react with :runner: to run + gym, or :mountain: to skip run and meet at the gym at 7. (Or just say 'skip')
Maya: I can bring a spare pair of climbing shoes (9.5) if anyone needs. Also, is chalk provided at the gym?
Jared: Route for the run: 2 loops of Cranky Park to keep it flat and scenic. Plan: meet 6:00pm outside the lobby, jog 6:05-6:35, shower quick, head to gym by 7.
Kevin: 6 works better for me — wanna get warmups in.
Priya: Adding to calendar now: https://calendar.app/redwood/event/12345 (mock link)
fitbot: Friendly reminder: bring a water bottle + something with electrolytes if it's warm :droplet:
Sam: I'm in. Also, last week I finally sent V3 — totally hyped to try the V4 lines. If anyone wants beta on routes I can coach a bit. :clap:
Maria: Can someone grab chalk? I left mine at home and the lockers are tiny.
Connor: I'll grab a block of chalk. No prob.
Maya: @Connor thanks! Also FYI the gym enforces street shoes in the lobby, so bring slippers for the walk.
Jared: Nice catch. Also, casual rule: no phones on the wall during attempts unless it's to film a send. Keep the ego low and the encouragement high :heart:
Kevin: Who's bringing a headlamp? Kidding. But maybe bring a small towel.
Priya: Poll result (quick count): :runner: 4, :mountain: 2, undecided 2 — looks like run + gym hybrid wins.
Sam: Woot. Also if anyone is trying weights earlier in the day, let's do a 20-min pre-climb mobility routine I can drop later.
Maria: I'll take that mobility — hamstrings need mercy.
Jared: Ok team — see you Wed 6pm. If anything changes I'll update the thread. GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/run-climb-abc123
Maya: Pumped. Thanks for organizing, Jared! :raised_hands:
Priya: Coffee on me for whoever beats their last week's V-grade. Friendly trash-talk encouraged.
fitbot: Post-thread summary: Wed 6pm meet lobby, 5k jog (2 loops Cranky Park), gym arrival ~7pm, 3-route mini-challenge. Hydration tip included. Have fun and be safe!
